description: This file defines FastAPI API routes for managing notes, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, searching, uploading attachments, and bulk operations. It interacts with SQLAlchemy models and includes security and analytics integrations.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: List[Tag] _get_or_create_tags(db: Session, names: List[str])
methods.description: Helper function to fetch existing tags or create new tags in the database based on provided tag names.

methods.name: create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new note with optional tags and category, returning the created note.

methods.name: list_notes(db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns all notes belonging to the current user.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note owned by the current user by ID.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note owned by the current user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a note owned by the current user.

methods.name: upload_attachment(note_id: int, file: UploadFile = File(...), db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Uploads a file attachment to a note, saves it to a directory, and creates an Attachment record.

methods.name: search_notes(payload: SearchQuery, db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Performs an advanced search for notes based on query, tags, categories, privacy, and archive status.

methods.name: bulk_action(payload: BulkAction, db: Session = Depends(get_session), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Performs bulk operations (delete, archive, category assignment, privacy setting) on multiple notes.
